_about: Manifest of the kiwrap patch series carried by the fork (docs/UPSTREAM.md 3.2-3.3). `patches[]`: id, gap (G-card), branch mr/<issue>-<slug>, issue, mr, status (local|issue-open|in-review|merged|upstream-fixed-differently|abandoned), parked (true = carried in the fork but not on any product path nor registered build: docs/DECISIONS.md D20), keys (capability keys that must ALL probe true for kiwrap.patches to list the id), commands (IPC commands whose T5 outcome may differ from the stock snapshot). `builds[]`: kiwrap-build/* tags (lightweight: annotated tags break git describe and every CMake reconfigure) that were built, T5-snapshotted and installed; `commit` is the BUILT commit (the integration branch's sha, what <prefix>/kiwrap-install.json records), `base` the upstream commit it was built on; kiwrap.patched_build is true for an install whose commit matches one. The data/ package is the only place besides backends/ allowed to name versions and commits.

patches.note: 2026-09-19: JOB_EXPORT_PCB_RATSNEST + `kicad-cli pcb export ratsnest [--units U] [--nets N1,N2] [--include-routed]` (JSON only, resources/schemas/ratsnest.v1.json; item pairs the project excludes as DRC unconnected_items are listed with `excluded: true` and left out of the counts and lengths; a through item's end is reported on the layer it shares with the other end) + board_commands.proto GetRatsnest (Since: 11.0, RatsnestEdge.excluded) + API_HANDLER_PCB::handleGetRatsnest; QA: qa_pcbnew RatsnestReport (5 cases incl. issue17429 exclusions and the ratsnest_layers fixture), qa_cli test_pcb_export_ratsnest + _exclusions, qa_api ApiE2E/GetRatsnest. The T5 inventory cannot see GetRatsnest until kicad-python is regenerated against the branch (kiwrap's client builds the message classes from a descriptor, backends.ipc.queries.ratsnest_messages), so `commands` is informational for now. RunBoardJobExportRatsnest (the job over IPC) is deliberately not part of the patch: GetRatsnest returns the data without a file round trip, the CLI/jobset half runs the job, and the extra proto/enum/QA surface is a follow-up once GetRatsnest lands.

2026-09-20: JOB_EXPORT_PCB_SPECCTRA + `kicad-cli pcb export specctra [-o FILE] BOARD` (KiCad's own DSN::ExportBoardToSpecctraFile as a headless job; default output <board>.dsn in the working directory; a malformed outline is a wxLogWarning on stderr and the bounding box is written) and JOB_IMPORT_PCB_SPECCTRA_SES + `kicad-cli pcb import-ses --ses FILE [-o OUT_BOARD] BOARD` (DSN::ImportSpecctraSession in a board-editor BOARD_COMMIT on the headless tool manager, exactly the editor's File > Import > Specctra Session: unlocked tracks/arcs/vias replaced by the session's routes, locked ones kept, SES placement applied to every named footprint including locked ones, unresolved references/layers/padstacks counted and warned, DRC markers dropped; a session without its sections -> exit 3 and the board untouched; without -o the board is saved in place, the project file is not written). `import-ses` is a sibling of `pcb import` because argparse only looks for a subcommand once a command's positionals are consumed and `pcb import` takes the file as its positional. Two commits (one per command), each with the qa_pcbnew cases in test_specctra_export.cpp (export contents; replacement/locked/placement semantics) and the qa_cli cases in test_pcb_specctra.py (DSN contents, DSN->SES->import round trip within the 1 um the DSN's six significant digits keep, locked copper + in-place save, error paths). Drafts: docs/upstream/drafts/specctra-jobs-export-mr.md, specctra-jobs-import-mr.md. Observed while testing, not fixed here: KiCad's own DSN reader (SPECCTRA_DB::LoadPCB) rejects KiCad's export at `(PN ...)` because the keyword table only knows `pn`; nothing in KiCad reads DSN files, so this is inert.

2026-09-20: env-var-gated input mode KICAD_INPUT_FROM_EVENTS=1|cloak (docs/DISPLAY.md 12.5, docs/research/display/win-input-patch.md): KIPLATFORM::UI::GetMousePosition/GetMouseState/IsKeyDown answer from event-derived state, WarpPointer moves only the reported pointer, a process-wide wxEventFilter records pointer/buttons, mirrors key transitions with SetKeyboardState, synthesises wxEVT_CHAR_HOOK from wxEVT_KEY_DOWN and drops spurious LEAVE events; `cloak` additionally DWMWA_CLOAKs every wx top-level on show so a KiCad driven with PostMessage only (the kiwrap-live helper's events injector) is invisible on the desktop while Windows.Graphics.Capture still streams it. No CLI / IPC surface: the key `gui.input_from_events` is derived from the builds[] entry of the built commit (capability.build_carries_patch), never probed. `cloak` stays fork-only; the upstream draft is docs/upstream/drafts/display-input-mr.md (held under D19). Measured on pcbnew; eeschema / project sessions untested (DISPLAY.md 12.8 row 14). 2026-09-20 D20: PARKED - the live view of a stock KiCad with native interaction (Raise KiCad) is the product path; mr/display-input stays in the private fork, is not merged into kiwrap/6dd893f7d1, and no registered build lists it. The helper's `events` injector remains behind the experimental kiwrap.live.inputMode setting.
